incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate detected from /v1/generate on inference-gateway (total 5xx rate 14% over 5m) — top upstream: lb-pool-inference-v2. Pager: alice (oncall-sre). :rotating_light:

alice (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Can someone confirm scope? Is this all regions or only us-west-2?

ben (edge-eng): seeing spike from us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Metrics show increased 502/504 from envoy proxies. Heap of retries logged.

carla (runtime-eng): adding logs. Recent gateway deploy? I see an Envoy config push 30m ago that changed route retry_policy for /v1/generate.

ben (edge-eng): yep that rollout touched route match -> added retry: on-5xx with num_retries:3 and per-try-timeout 2s.

alice (oncall-sre): ok. My suspicion: retries + fanout -> amplification -> backend overload -> 502s. Can we reduce retries or disable?

carla (runtime-eng): I can patch envoy route to remove retries from the HTTP connection manager. Quick command I will run on the config service: `curl -XPOST https://configsvc/api/v1/overrides -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","retries":null}'`

ben (edge-eng): +1 do it, but also circuit breaker settings might be currently low for lb-pool-inference-v2 — we should increase max pending requests and reduce max retries fallback.

alice (oncall-sre): while carla patches, I'll start traffic shaping to reduce fanout. Planning to shift 60% of traffic to lb-pool-inference-v1 (stable). ben can you apply route weight shift?

ben (edge-eng): on it. Pushing weight change via traffic-controller: `tc shift --from lb-pool-inference-v2 --to lb-pool-inference-v1 --percent 60 --reason "mitigate retry amplification"`

incident-bot: deploybot: rollout started for traffic-controller change (change_id: tc-2026-03-15-01).

carla (runtime-eng): patch applied on configsvc. Envoy config hot-reload triggered. Confirming route now has no retry policy.

alice (oncall-sre): observing metrics. 5xx rate dropping from 14% to ~8% after weight shift and retry removal. Latency stable.

dan (customer-success): any customer-facing impact? Are there errors visible to users or retries causing duplicated charges?

eva (platform-pm): we should prepare a short blurb. Waiting on final severity.

alice (oncall-sre): preliminary: degraded for a subset of API calls for ~25 minutes, higher error rate ~peak 14% → customers using large-batch/generate saw timeouts. No data loss. No auth issues.

ben (edge-eng): I found a config diff: envoys had `circuit_breakers: max_retries: 5` on that route and `max_pending_requests: 50` per upstream. With increased retries it filled. I propose we raise pending to 200 and clamp retries to 1 for a safer default.

carla (runtime-eng): agree. I'll apply a conservative cb patch: set max_pending_requests=200, max_retries=1 on lb-pool-inference-v2 and monitor.

alice (oncall-sre): going to run a quick smoke: replay a subset of traffic against v2 with realistic fanout. If cb holds, we can slowly shift traffic back.

incident-bot: metric-alert resolved — 5xx rate below threshold for 5m. (alert cleared) :white_check_mark:

alice (oncall-sre): smoke results: v2 now stable under sampled load. 5xx back to baseline (~0.5%). I'll keep traffic at 30% to v2 for 15m then reevaluate.

dan (customer-success): prepping support note. ETA for a public incident update?

eva (platform-pm): let's wait until post-mortem. For now internal incident summary will go out. If customers ask, send statement: "We observed elevated errors in inference path affecting a subset of requests; mitigation applied; no data loss; monitoring in place."

carla (runtime-eng): full postmortem checklist: record the config diff (pre/post), list timeline, root cause = retry policy change + conservative cb/pending defaults that caused overload amplification. Action items: 1) add canary gating for route-level retry changes, 2) telemetry alert for retry-amplification pattern (retries up + 5xx spike), 3) set safer defaults for new route configs.

ben (edge-eng): I'll open the PR with gating + test harness for route changes. Reference: `envoy-route-tests/replicate-retry-amplify` will simulate fanout.

alice (oncall-sre): final status: Incident resolved, partial traffic shift ongoing (v2 at 30%), config rollback and cb adjustment applied. I'll file incident follow-up and schedule postmortem tomorrow. Thank you all. :heart:

incident-bot: NOTE — oncall handoff scheduled: alice -> next-oncall at 1755563600.

carla (runtime-eng): quick logs dump for traceability: ```
[2026-03-15T01:02:12Z] envoy: [upstream] 502 upstream reset: request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate upstream=lb-pool-inference-v2 retries=3 pending=48
[2026-03-15T01:03:10Z] envoy: [upstream] 504 upstream timeout: request_id=abc999 route=/v1/generate upstream=lb-pool-inference-v2 retries=3 pending=50
```

ben (edge-eng): closing notes: avoid enabling aggressive retry policies without concurrent increase in cb/pending thresholds. Put a config lint blocker for route retry >1 without a review.

alice (oncall-sre): logged incident ticket INF-2026-037. Postmortem owner: carla. I'll hand off for normal daytime ops. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
